evidence.summary: Done-when IF-003 check: src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx imports brand data only from @/api/brandApi (getBrand, saveBrand, saveBrandLogo, removeBrandLogo, resetBrand, brandLogoUrl, Brand type). It also imports isApiError from @/api/httpClient, a shared error guard rather than a second contract. brandLogoImage.ts imports only the BrandLogoUpload type from brandApi. No fetch() calls in the unit files.

Read review of AC-ra-20/AC-ra-21 behavior in the unit: brandLogoImage.ts checks size <= 2 MB and PNG/JPEG magic bytes before decoding, shrinks to 600 px on the longer side in the same format, and refuses with 'Use uma imagem PNG ou JPG de até 2 MB.' leaving the saved and picked state unchanged. BrandSection.tsx saves fields before the logo, keeps fields on a refused logo and shows the server message in the logo field, and routes 'Remover logo' and 'Voltar para a marca FitPulse' through ConfirmDialog (its onConfirm rejections are shown in the dialog). Cover preview mirrors server resolveBrand (blank name -> FitPulse).

messages.text: Once the backend brand units are merged: run `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts` (bounded output, save the exit code). Selectors: section data-aioson-id=brand-section (SettingsPage.tsx), form brand-form, inputs #brand-name, #brand-phone, #brand-email, #brand-website, file input #brand-logo-file, buttons brand-save, brand-logo-remove, brand-reset, dialogs brand-logo-remove-confirm and brand-reset-confirm, status brand-status. Confirm GET /api/brand/logo is readable by a plain without a Bearer header (thumbnail and cover preview depend on it).

Play dev-link walkthrough still open: save a PNG logo and a JPG logo, confirm the cover preview updates from the server answer, then export the three PDFs and confirm the brand name, contact line, credit and logo appear. Also check a >2 MB or non-PNG/JPG file is refused with 'Use uma imagem PNG ou JPG de até 2 MB.' without changing the saved brand.

The cover preview (previewCoverPage in BrandSection.tsx) copies the server cover copy from server/report/documentParts.ts (resolveBrand, contact line 'phone · email · site', credit wording). If that server copy changes, update previewCoverPage or move the shared copy to shared/.
